meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会自己开浏览器干活:打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取网页数据、测试网页。页面状态会在多次脚本之间保留,可以分小步逐步完成一个任务。
howto.when: 当你要求浏览网站、填表、截图、抓取网页数据等浏览器操作,或说出 “go to [url]”、“click on” 这类短语时接管。若不确定用哪种模式,它会先问你。

say.text: 打开 example.com,截一张图给我看看
say.note: 启动浏览器打开该页并保存截图

say.text: 帮我登录这个网站,然后填写并提交表单
say.note: 在保留的页面上继续操作

say.text: 抓取这个列表页的数据
say.note: 可按原文做法拦截并回放网络请求

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a browser itself: open URLs, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, and test web pages. Page state persists across script runs, so a task can be finished in small steps.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for browser actions such as navigating sites, filling forms, taking screenshots, or extracting web data, or when you say things like "go to [url]" or "click on". If the mode is unclear, it asks you first.

say_en.text: Go to example.com and take a screenshot for me
say_en.note: Launches the browser, opens the page, saves a screenshot

say_en.text: Log into this site, then fill out and submit the form
say_en.note: Continues working on the kept-alive page

say_en.text: Scrape the data from this list page
say_en.note: Can intercept and replay network requests
